messages:
Nina: quick report from the bootcamp labs: users hitting a hard JSON schema error when using jsonMode + function calls in the JS quickstart. looks like the streaming joiner is inserting a separator and also leaving a trailing newline token. repro below.

Nina: repro (node):
```js
const sdk = new RedwoodSDK({ jsonMode: true, streaming: true });
await sdk.chat.complete({
  model: 'rw-mini',
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'calculate 1' }],
  functions: [{ name: 'calc', parameters: { type: 'object', properties: { n: { type: 'number' } }, required: ['n'] } }]
});
```

Nina: observed stream chunks (local):
```
chunkA: '{"name":"calc","arguments":{"n":1}}'
chunkB: ','
chunkC: '\n'
assembled: '{"name":"calc","arguments":{"n":1}},\n'
JSON.parse error: Unexpected token \n in JSON at position 34
```

Harold: ugh. which sdk and samplekit versions?

Nina: js-sdk@0.9.0-snapshot, samplekit v0.17, started with `npm run dev`. py-sdk users not seeing this (reported by a partner).

Yuki: sounds like two issues: (1) serializer emits separator chunk for multi-object streams, (2) joiner doesn't trim trailing whitespace/newline before JSON.parse. py-sdk likely trims or tolerates.

Harold: can you confirm whether the server is sending a trailing separator or the client joiner is synthesizing it?

Nina: captured wiredump: server sent object, then stream-close. no explicit separator. client-side serializer appended "," in finish path then a small newline flush from the pretty-print path. race between finish and prettyPrinter.

Yuki: fix plan: 1) make serializer idempotent about separators (only emit if buffer not ending with separator), 2) remove standalone pretty-printer newline in streaming mode, 3) defensive trim before final parse as a short-term bandaid. add regression test comparing JS <> Py assembled bytes.

Harold: agree. patch hierarchy: sdk/streaming/serializer.ts patch + samplekit e2e test. also add test in devex/bootcamp runner so we catch this on CI.

Nina: pushed a draft PR with a minimal fix and tests: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/230 (WIP). includes a fallback in joiner: `final = final.trim();` before JSON.parse.

ci-bot: samplekit-ci build #512 queued

Harold: if fallback remains, make it an opt-in flag (jsonMode: 'strict' | 'permissive') so we don't mask other bugs.

Yuki: agreed on opt-in. but for bootcamp we can flip permissive by default in the quickstart container image to reduce churn for users until patch lands. add a note in onboarding docs.

Nina: added a short troubleshooting blurb in docs and a sample snippet showing how to enable permissive mode. will update PR after CI.

ci-bot: samplekit-ci build #512 failed (logs: https://ci.internal/samplekit/512)

Harold: CI failure looks like a lint precommit in a totally unrelated file. re-run once lint fix merged.

Nina: rebase done, now rerunning CI. thanks all. :raised_hands:
